title: AWKUM and NCEG, University of Peshawar Sign MoU to Strengthen Academic and Research Collaboration
text:
The Department
of Geology, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) and the National Center
of Excellence in Geology (NCEG), University of Peshawar signed a Memorandum of
Understanding (MoU) to strengthen academic cooperation, promote joint research
and new opportunities for students and faculty of both institutions.

The MoU was
formally signed at NCEG by Prof. Dr. Liaqat Ali, Director NCEG and Dr. Muhammad
Sajid, Chairman, Department of Geology, AWKUM. Both the institutions reaffirmed
their commitment to strengthening academic cooperation and advancing geological
research.
